objective: Verify the portable Agent Skill upload route in claude.ai/Cowork separately from Claude Code.
scenario: An owner with an eligible account uploads peanuts-agent-skill.zip using Anthropic’s current custom-Skills UI and invokes the skill in that product surface.
expected_behaviors: The portable ZIP is accepted by the current upload flow.
The skill appears and can be invoked in that exact product surface.
The host-specific tool and file-access limitations are documented.
Claude Code filesystem installation is not assumed to synchronize with claude.ai.
prohibited_behaviors: Claim upload success without observing the actual UI.
Assume Claude Code, claude.ai, and API Skills synchronize automatically.
